# datadog_fleet_schedules (Data Source)

Lists Fleet Automation Agent upgrade schedules in ID order. An empty result is successful. Reading schedules requires an application key with the `hosts_read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Returns an empty list when the organization has no Fleet Automation schedules.
data "datadog_fleet_schedules" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `schedules` (Attributes List) Fleet Automation schedules, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of schedules returned by the API.

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was created.
- `created_by` (String) User handle of the person who created the schedule.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the Fleet Automation schedule.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default schedule.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the schedule.
- `next_run` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the next maintenance window, or null when no next run can be computed.
- `notification_rule` (Attributes) Notification configuration attached to the schedule, when available. (See [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--notification_rule).)
- `query` (String) Datadog host query used to select the Agent upgrade targets.
- `rule` (Attributes) Recurrence and maintenance-window configuration for the schedule. (See [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--rule).)
- `status` (String) Whether the schedule is `active` or `inactive`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was last updated.
- `updated_by` (String) User handle of the person who last updated the schedule.
- `version_to_latest` (Number) Number of major Agent versions behind the latest version targeted by the schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--schedules--notification_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.notification_rule`

Read-Only:

- `handles` (Set of String) Notification handles, such as Slack channels or PagerDuty integrations.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the notification rule.


<a id="nestedatt--schedules--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.rule`

Read-Only:

- `days_of_week` (Set of String) Days when the schedule may run.
- `interval` (Number) Interval between schedule runs in weeks.
- `maintenance_window_duration` (Number) Duration of the maintenance window in minutes.
- `start_maintenance_window` (String) Start of the maintenance window in canonical 24-hour `HH:MM` format.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone used to interpret the maintenance window.
